about.en: Quantum Inu is a Solana meme token at the Token-2022 mint 8TiMkgvsrat9tM2esko8zVTt99LZLpefUM4SnZaziXaQ, whose on-chain metadata carries the name Quantum Inu and the symbol QI, with 6 decimals, no mint or freeze authority and a fixed supply of about 952.7 million tokens. Its metadata names pqc.market, a launch site built on pump.fun that signs its listings with post-quantum WOTS and Merkle signatures, as the site it was created on; the token has no project website or official social account beyond those launch pages. It is unrelated to BENQI, whose token also uses the symbol QI.
